title: Finding King Trump
author: Beautiful_Bid_12345
selftext: So i made this fast type Arcade game where you are in the haunted White House to find King Trump , you need to collect 100 souls to escape this White House Hallway , a ghost will appear to chase you and you can only run backward (moonwalk) if you accidentially see it (Like Medusa inspation) ... First level you have a lot of space to run around ... But Later on , Ghost Columns or Furniture will appear more to block your way . I want to add that you can use souls to remove columns & furniture (which reduce a chance you reach your goal) , Im not sure if i should add more different weird dancing ghosts as i dont know if the game is easy to play yet ... Any new ideas to add to my game ? Thanks.
